title: Phase A: self-anchor plan-anchor
description:
## Purpose

Implement docs/plans/phase-a/plan.md against the locked anchors and the skills/agents guideline baseline. This epic owns the executable Phase A sprint graph; the markdown plan explains rationale and acceptance details.

## Success Criteria

Every sprint closes with its acceptance criteria satisfied, offline validation passes, and the independently tuned planning gate covers every locked anchor after explicit authorization for the scoped Jev payload.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Every Phase A sprint is closed with its acceptance criteria satisfied.
- [ ] Offline quality gates pass.
- [ ] Independent question tuning and the live planning gate are recorded after explicit authorization.
- [ ] Every locked anchor is covered.

title: A1: runner contract and single trust resolution
description: Implement the skill-level runner contract and deterministic resolver described in docs/plans/phase-a/plan.md. Resolve the harness registry path, frontmatter version, role model, and SHA-256 once; invoke through Agent with one fenced JSON params object; validate one fenced JSON result; record redacted attestation. Remove installation-path and version checks from individual agents without weakening repository-input confinement. Anchors: ANC-001, ANC-002, ANC-003, ANC-004, ANC-008, ANC-012.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Resolution is confined to the plugin root and fails closed on traversal, symlink escape, mismatch, or malformed registry.
- [ ] Each invocation resolves exactly once and passes an immutable runtime descriptor.
- [ ] Active instructions use Agent, never Task.
- [ ] Input/output fencing, timeout, malformed JSON, and redacted attestation tests pass.

title: A2: tracker-neutral bd and br operations
description: Add the small tracker adapter described in docs/plans/phase-a/plan.md. Select one valid tracker at the orchestration boundary and normalize show, children, create, update, and comment for both bd and br. Accept typed operation data only and construct argv without a shell. Anchors: ANC-004, ANC-007, ANC-008, ANC-013.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] bd and br fixture contracts produce the same normalized results.
- [ ] Ambiguous or missing tracker selection returns a typed error.
- [ ] Agents contain no bd-versus-br command branching.
- [ ] Command-string params are rejected and argv construction is injection-safe.

title: A3: reduce environment variables and make offline mode explicit
description: Remove every plan-anchor application environment read except TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Replace URL, model, threshold, size, confirmation, author, and remote-opt-in environment settings with explicit flags or checked-in defaults. Remove --allow-remote; a live command plus key is sufficient, while --dry-run and fixture answers never create or call transport. Anchors: ANC-005, ANC-006, ANC-011, ANC-012.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Static validation finds only TYPESAFE_API_KEY as an application-specific environment read.
- [ ] Live execution requires the key but no second opt-in.
- [ ] Dry-run and fixture-answer tests observe zero transport calls with no key.
- [ ] Help, errors, and docs contain no removed environment variable or --allow-remote guidance.

title: A4: simplify harness-specific agents
description: Update all Claude and Codex agent definitions to consume the structured params and tracker contracts from A1/A2. Remove duplicated trust bootstrap and direct tracker commands while retaining workspace path validation, single responsibility, typed errors, timeout semantics, and fenced output. Preserve separate harness files and the independent tuner. Anchors: ANC-001, ANC-003, ANC-004, ANC-009, ANC-010, ANC-014.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] All six definitions pass required-section, schema, registry, and model-role validation.
- [ ] No agent searches installation paths or validates its own version.
- [ ] The tuner receives no current plan verdict or make-this-pass objective.
- [ ] No arch-qa or req-qa reference exists in the plugin.

title: A5: mechanical guideline and regression gates
description: Extend repository validation so the guideline baseline and all locked deterministic checks are executable. Cover frontmatter, registries, model roles, manifests, structured params, fenced responses, Agent-tool wording, environment allowlist, tracker contracts, command injection, and secret canaries while keeping the full judge suite green. Anchors: all.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Every locked anchor has an executable deterministic assertion.
- [ ] Negative fixtures fail for the intended rule.
- [ ] CI rejects wrong models, Task-tool instructions, forbidden env reads, unfenced payloads, raw secrets, and direct tracker branches in agents.
- [ ] Version-sync and all offline unit tests pass.

title: A6: documentation, realistic examples, and self-gate
description: Synchronize README, SKILL.md, references, PRD, architecture docs, examples, and marketplace-facing descriptions with the Phase A contracts. Document bd and br without claiming database compatibility. Replace removed env-var and prose invocation examples. After explicit authorization, independently tune questions and run the planning gate to full coverage. Anchors: ANC-001, ANC-004, ANC-007, ANC-009, ANC-010, ANC-011, ANC-013, ANC-014.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Documentation consistency and executable example tests pass.
- [ ] Jev is identified as required and offline modes as development/CI aids.
- [ ] bd/br and fenced params examples use current paths, flags, and JSON shapes.
- [ ] Latest authorized planning runs pass every locked anchor with no uncovered anchor.
